description: Permanently delete a Hostsmith site and all of its deployed files. **Destructive - only call after explicit user confirmation.** The site URL becomes unreachable immediately and the content cannot be recovered. The user must pass `confirm: true` for the deletion to proceed; otherwise the call returns an error explaining the safeguard.

confirm.description: Set to true only after the user has explicitly confirmed they want to permanently delete this site. Required safeguard - never pass true speculatively.

partition.description: Data partition the site lives in. Omit to use the user's home partition.

siteId.description: The site ID to delete (from `list_sites` or `get_site`).

name: delete_site
